name: 404-humannotfound/php-mysql-over-ssh-tunnel
description: Framework-agnostic PHP library that transparently establishes (or reuses) an SSH local-port-forward tunnel to a remote MySQL server and exposes the local port as a PHP constant.

suggest.ext-posix: Allows reliable PID liveness checks (posix_kill($pid, 0)) when detecting an already-running tunnel. Without it the library falls back to checking /proc/{pid} on Linux, or treats PID liveness as unknown and relies on the port probe alone.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Needed by your application to actually connect to MySQL through the tunnel (and by the optional integration test).
